item.title: Says the prompt is empty when pasting JSON
item.body:
Type: Bug I'm asking Copilot to edit some JSON and it's saying either it can't see the file I have open or if I paste the JSON directly into the chat prompt, it says the prompt is empty. Steps to reproduce: 1. Open a text file and paste in JSON 2a. Open Copilot and ask it to modify a part of the JSON Observe Copilot says it can't see the file 2b. Paste JSON to Copilot and ask it to modify directly Observe Copilot says the prompt is empty Extension version: 0.28.0 VS Code version: Code 1.101.0 (dfaf44141ea9deb3b4096f7cd6d24e00c147a4b1, 2025-06-11T15:00:50.123Z) OS version: Linux x64 6.8.0-60-generic Modes:
